findings.message: zebra stripes add clutter, and a shaded row looks highlighted; rows set well apart are scanned without them
findings.title: no zebra stripes

source.shows: a table alone for looking values up, formatted in the book's order: every digit (whole dollars are required), two thin rules and no grid, the rows set well apart with no stripes, a wider gutter before the Total column, dates of fixed width, the numbers right-aligned and bare, the unit once in the title, nothing bold but the title, the three outliers on a light grey fill; the dates of the book's earlier versions (21 Jul, 1 Sep: its last version has 21 Jun and 1 Oct); at 480 pt, wider than the text
